claim: No. 1 on the chart dated December 27, 1969: Someday We'll Be Together, Diana Ross & The Supremes (covers Jan 1-2, 1970)
No. 1 on January 3, 1970: Raindrops Keep Fallin' On My Head, B.J. Thomas (first 1970 chart, a Saturday)
You Light Up My Life, Debby Boone, first week at No. 1 on October 15, 1977
Last chart of the decade dated December 29, 1979: Escape (The Pina Colada Song), Rupert Holmes
Raindrops reached No. 1 in the issue dated January 3, displacing the final chart-topper of 1969, Someday We'll Be Together by Diana Ross & the Supremes
